question: Which city hosted the fifth edition of the Indo-Indonesian Joint Bilateral Maritime Exercise, ‘Samudra Shakti – 2025’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Visakhapatnam.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The fifth edition of the Indo-Indonesian Joint Bilateral Maritime Exercise, ‘Samudra Shakti – 2025’, is being hosted at Visakhapatnam by the Indian Navy.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Exercise ‘Samudra Shakti’ aims at enhancing interoperability and strengthening mutual understanding between the Indian and Indonesian navies.**
 
• **The exercise was first conducted in 2018 and is a key bilateral engagement between the two countries.**
 
• **The exercise consists of two phases: Harbour Phase and Sea Phase.**
 
• **The Sea Phase includes various operational coordination exercises such as Helicopter Operations, Air Defence Exercises, and Weapon Firing Drills.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Harbour Phase__

 __
 
• Focuses on building camaraderie and enhancing professional understanding between the two navies.
 
 
 
• Sea Phase__
 
 
• Involves complex operational coordination with drills such as VBSS (Visit, Board, Search and Seizure), Helicopter Operations, and Air Defence Exercises.
 
• These activities improve the capabilities of both navies in responding to various maritime challenges.
